app.name: Morris GC
home.title: Model library
home.subtitle: Pick a model and explain rotation, revolution and the seasons with an interactive 3D scene.
home.emptyHint: Models are checked and downloaded on startup. Offline: drop model folders into .GC/model/ and reopen, or retry from the Download page once online.
home.deleteConfirm: Delete the model "{0}"? Its files will be removed from the local library.
home.recent: Select a model, then press Launch
home.launchHint: Models open in their own window with play/pause, view controls and teaching notes.
dl.title: Download
dl.subtitle: Import a model source: git repository, zip archive or local folder. The model/ folder in the repo is the model list.
dl.pickSource: Select a source to see available models
dl.hint: GitHub / GitLab / Gitee repository URLs, zip links and local folders are supported
dl.error.unreachable: Cannot reach this source, check the URL or network
set.title: Settings
set.subtitle: Model sources, startup memory allocation and local storage.
set.fps.desc: Higher is smoother but uses more CPU.
set.memory.desc: The launcher hands this budget to each model; models decide how much data to cache with it.
set.memory.hint: 2048 MB or more is recommended; 1024 MB for low-end devices.
set.preallocate.desc: Faster first frame, slightly slower startup.
set.sources.desc: Disabled sources are hidden from the Download page.
set.checkUpdate.desc: Check on startup whether models and the launcher are up to date.
update.title: Auto update
update.desc: Models take effect immediately after download; launcher updates apply on the next start.
update.offline: Update server unavailable — continuing with local models
update.noManifest: No remote version manifest — continuing with local models
update.noChange: Models and launcher are up to date
update.pendingReady: Launcher {0} is ready, applies on next start
update.pendingDownloaded: Launcher {0} downloaded, applies on next start
update.noPackageUrl: Launcher {0} found, but no download address
player.windowHint: The model runs in its own window; close it to exit
player.errorHint: The model package has no usable assembly. Make sure <id>.model contains the model dll, or re-download it.
